name: Restart Trail
aliases: Short stack traversal with restart trail
Wide BVH Traversal with Short Stack
Wide BVH Traversal with a Short Stack
definition: A stackless or short-stack traversal algorithm for BVH ray casting that enables restarts from the root by storing one bit of data per hierarchy level to track which parts of the tree have been processed.
summary: Restart Trail is a stackless BVH traversal algorithm that uses a compact bit-array to track processed tree levels, enabling full stack exhaustion without losing state.
